# Verdaca

> A productized multi-agent deliberation platform. Where most AI agent tools generate one answer from one model, Verdaca runs specialized agents through structured deliberation — they critique each other, synthesize evidence, and converge on outputs you can verify.

Verdaca's distinguishing feature is substrate-neutrality: every external dependency — memory store, model gateway, compaction strategy, quality gates — sits behind a ratified port contract enforced by no-waiver tests. Adapters snap in like Lego (swap Mem0 for Letta, swap one provider for another, swap an in-process compactor for a managed one), and agent workflows never break, because they only ever talk to the port, not the substrate underneath.

Two axes of pluggability:

- Horizontal: swap agent personas (strategy / engineering / UX / data science / custom packs) without touching the kernel
- Vertical: swap substrate adapters (Mem0/Letta · Anthropic/OpenAI · Forge/Caveman) without touching agents

Audience: consultants, analysts, strategists, technical leaders, founders — decision-makers whose work is too consequential to outsource to one AI's first answer, but who can't always pull a real human team into the room.

Verdaca Studio runs at ~$2.50 / ~12 min per session (internal scoring; A4 deferred). The Studio output is a scored, auditable deliberation trail showing each agent's reasoning, what was challenged, and how the final synthesis was reached — with dissenting positions preserved rather than averaged away.

## Technical posture

- Architecture: Workflows → Agents → Kernel → Ports → Adapters (layered Lego pattern; substrate-neutral by construction)
- Memory adapters shipping: Mem0 (hybrid vector + graph store, Apache-2.0) and Letta (stateful session memory, Apache-2.0) — both pass the same conformance suite
- No customer-facing API: Verdaca is delivered as a CLI / tool / package, not a hosted API service. Local config, local kernel, local adapters. LLM provider credentials live as environment variables in the practitioner's environment; Verdaca does not store or proxy API keys
- All metric citations carry the A4-deferred caveat: `(internal scoring; A4 deferred)` until Stage 7 ratifies external validation

## Status

LIVE 2026-05-11. Static site (HTML + CSS, no JavaScript). Built and ratified through a closed design cycle (Phase 2, D-9 second clean cycle against the Verdaca design system substrate v1.0).
